notes.title: Update 0.7516
notes.notes:
This is just a small patch with some tiny bug fixes and tweaks.

Most notably the book now has an updated appearance.

Thank you to everyone who reports bugs to me! :)

More content and new features coming soon!

notes.title: Update 0.7512
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who gave feedback, commented in the forums, wrote reviews or even created video reviews of Jasper!! <3

Here is a first batch of improvements based on the input:

[h3]Chapter Selection[/h3]
[list]
    [*]You can now replay any levels and chapters you have previously finished.
    [*]All soul dust you earn while replaying the levels will be added on top of your already collected soul dust.
    [*]Feel free to start hoarding soul dust for the next levels this way. If it's too broken I might change this in the future though.[/list]
[h3]Book[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Narration on first page can now be skipped
    [*]Skipping through book pages now skips through individual lines instead of the whole page. Continuing to skip during page turns still skips whole pages.[/list]
[h3]Level Tweaks[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Tweaked interaction cameras in attic
    [*]Made attic a little brighter
    [*]Increased duration of boy sequence right after the poem by the well, so it's less easy to miss[/list]
[h3]Tutorials[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Added controls tooltips as a basic tutorial and reminder during gameplay. Will add a setting to deactivate any tutorial overlays in the future.
    [*]The button prompt during sequences now fades out after a while for more immersion.[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Post process bloom is now set correctly from the beginning
    [*]Jasper is not freezing anymore while charging a lantern
    [*]Tweaked audio levels: Music and sfx were too loud
    [*]Fixed minor bug when entering pause menu while a sequence is playing in the background
    [*]Fixed level change breaking when soft-restarting the game via the pause menu[/list]
[h3]Credits[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Increased visibility and added the link to the credits to various sub-menus. Credits will be integrated directly into the game in the future.[/list]

[spoiler]Grandma added some more apple pie to the game[/spoiler]
